assets: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Unreal Engine combat VFX flipbook. Generate ONE square RGBA sprite sheet on genuinely transparent background: EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equally sized square frames, chronological left to right then next row. Every frame has the same fixed center pivot and scale, 10% transparent margin, absolutely no borders, numbers, letters, characters, weapons, scene or checkerboard painted into image. Create the evolving hand-painted IMPACT of a powerful armored punch, inspired by Vi's physical contact in Arcane: a sharp ivory-white crushed star core, amber-orange tapered sparks and two or three broken white crescent shock fragments. Strong asymmetry along a left-to-right impact direction, angular brush-cut shapes with slight painted edge texture. No generic circular magic spell, no capsule shape, no cartoon word label. Timeline: frame1 tiny compressed white spark; frames2-3 rapid ignition; frames4-6 explosive directional maximum with white core and sparse long orange splinters; frames7-10 core tears into broken angular fragments with large negative-space holes; frames11-14 sparks spread outward and shrink; frames15-16 almost gone, only tiny dying orange sparks. Cohesive animation of the SAME effect, not 16 unrelated icons. Keep dense white hot area compact. All glow must remain local with soft alpha, no rectangular haze. Square canvas 1024x1024 or larger.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX flipbook. ONE square transparent RGBA sprite sheet, EXACTLY 4x4 evenly sized square cells, 16 frames read left to right top to bottom. Fixed center pivot and constant drawing scale, fully transparent spacing/margins. No grid lines, numbers, text, characters, weapons, scene, black background or painted checkerboard. Create a hand-painted electric-blue kinetic DETONATION inspired by Jayce's hextech energy discharge in Arcane. Blinding compact ivory-white jagged core, cobalt and cyan irregular tongues of energy, a few sharp branching white-blue lightning forks. An asymmetric radial energy explosion seen front-on, with open gaps and triangular broken shards. Timeline: frame1 tiny cyan ignition crack; frames2-3 white hot core forms; frames4-6 energetic maximum burst with outward blue-white jets and angular transparent gaps; frames7-10 hollow torn shock front expands as core disappears; frames11-14 separate tapering energy shards drift away; frames15-16 faint remnants and near empty. Designed to be layered as a world-space contact effect, not a fullscreen overlay. Cohesive hand-painted cel VFX, pronounced shape evolution; no perfect circles, no capsule or pill shapes, no smooth uniform blob. Local blue glow with real feathered alpha only around energy.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated electrical shock-front animation for a game. ONE square transparent RGBA 4-column x 4-row sprite sheet containing 16 chronological equally sized frames. Identical center pivot and constant scale. Leave generous transparent negative space, no borders, no text, no numbers, no background, no checkerboard. This is a separate SUPPORTING electric corona, not an explosion core: thin irregular white-hot and electric-cyan branching lightning arcs, three disjoint jagged curved fragments that spread outward from a completely EMPTY center. Arcane hextech-inspired hand-painted brush VFX, cobalt secondary edges, white thin main branches. Frames1-2 a couple short sparks near center; frames3-5 branches grow and fork rapidly; frames6-8 widest bright jagged broken corona; frames9-12 arcs separate, flicker thinner and break into small pieces; frames13-16 sparse fading blue sparks. Never draw a complete smooth ring or solid disk. The central 30% remains transparent in maximum frames, allowing the main punch and target to be seen. Restrained local glow. Each frame must contain only its own animation drawing inside that cell.
